name: Veggie Basic Soup
description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Richard's Sunday Soup
_similar.description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

_similar.keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Beef & Barley Soup
_similar.description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef barley soup, hearty soup, freezer-friendly

_similar.name: Chili Con Carne
_similar.description: A hearty and versatile chili recipe featuring ground beef, kidney beans, and a variety of vegetables, ideal for customization.
recipeIngredient: Optional: additional vegetables like zucchini, carrots, mushrooms

recipeInstructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly; drain off excess fat.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, celery, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, salt, and hot pepper sauce to the skillet.
Optionally add other desired vegetables (e.g., zucchini, carrots, mushrooms) at this stage.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: chili con carne, ground beef chili, customizable chili
